mechanism: zom20a (2 opcodes/round) executes its live loop (E2 F2 at window+2Bh) in rounds 4,7,10,13,... rev0 A patches it with INT 87h at instr 10 = round 10, so capture happens in round 10 if our team runs before the Zombie group (group order is random per battle), else in round 13. B writes [4A17h] at its instr 3 (round 3), before any possible A INT 87h (earliest instr 6), so the B write never limits capture time. With the location start (B082: v1=[1243h] valid in rounds 4-5, DI=15*v1) the earliest INT 87h is instr 9 (read 4, mul 5, xchg 6, les 7, mov dx 8), which gives capture in round 10 for both execution orders.

candidates.label: loc9
candidates.change: A: mov si,ax; mov bx,26FFh; mov cx,4A17h; mov ax,[1243h] (instr 4); mul word [si+k15]; xchg ax,di; les ax,[si+z20a_data] (dw F2E2h,1000h); mov dx,C381h; INT 87h at instr 9 (rev0 10), search starts at DI=15*v1 (B082 location idea); the [4A17h]->[9769h] copy is removed from A; rev0 8-bit band math unchanged + 1 nop so phoenix_init stays at turn 22. B: adds mov [9769h],bx at instr 4 (zombie_entry, the same value A used to copy); push cs/pop es/mov ax,F9EBh -> les ax,[si+bd_data] (dw F9EBh,1000h) + nop, so [5D13h] stays instr 5 and the startup INT 87h stays instr 12.

recommendation: Do not promote loc9 (screen ALL +0.0017, below the bar). Earlier zom20a capture is worth nothing measurable: capture rounds 7 (fixA), 10 (loc9) and 13 (locA2) all screen within noise of rev0, and the trace shows capture rate is already ~90% with losses after capture, not from timing. Close this card. Reusable piece for combinations: B can write [9769h] itself at instr 4 (les trick keeps its INT 87h at instr 12; RW not hurt), which frees 2 A startup instructions; with that, a decoy-proof location-start capture fits in A at instr 9 without delaying INT 87h past rev0.
